entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH ------

For the Petitioner : Mr. Arvind Kr. Choudhary, Advocate For the State : Ms. Kumari Rashmi, A.P.P.
For the Informant : Mr. Sanjeev Thakur, Advocate Mr. Aishwarya Prakash, Advocate -----
4/ 07.11.2025 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Jagarnathpur P.S. Case No. 209 of 2024 for the offences registered under Sections 406, 420, 467, 468, 471 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 138 of the N.I. Act, pending in the Court of Sri Mayank Maliyaz, learned Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi.
3. The petitioner is alleged to have taken Rs. 18,41,000/- from the informant to get her daughter admitted in medical college.
Later on, the petitioner misappropriated the said amount.
4. It was submitted that the petitioner is in custody since last eleven months.

5. Mr. Sanjeev Thakur, learned counsel appearing for the informant has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that there is documentary evidence to the effect that Rs. 18,41,000/-
has been given to the petitioner.
It was further submitted that one witness has been examined and the petitioner has not cross-examined the other witness, who had appeared to get his evidence recorded.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the submission made above, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Accordingly, his prayer for bail is rejected.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) 07.11.2025 / R.Kr.
